en: A Bottle in the Gaza Sea
ov: زجاجة في بحر غزة (الإنجليزية: A Bottle in the Gaza Sea) هو فيلم دراما تم إنتاجه في كندا وفرنسا وصدر في سنة 2011.
plotEn: Tal (Agathe Bonitzer) is the 17-year-old daughter of recent French immigrants to Israel who live in Jerusalem. Following a bomb attack on a local café, she throws a bottle into the sea near Gaza with a message asking for an explanation. Naïm (Mahmoud Shalaby), a sensitive but aimless 20-year-old Palestinian living in Gaza, discovers the bottle and tries to answer Tal's question by initiating an email correspondence. Their mutual suspicion soon develops into a tender friendship.
